ValidationRule.description: RETIRED by REV-60 (17 Jul 2026): the promo engine composes the Q automatically and refreshes on frequency changes; this QLE-time rule fired before the after-save engine and blocked blank new lines (UAT A2). Engine + backstop replace it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (NOT(CONTAINS(Promo_Code__c, "Q")) && text(SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__BillingFrequency__c) = 'Quarterly' && text(Division__c) = 'ALM' && SBQQ__Bundle__c = FALSE ) || (ISBLANK(Promo_Code__c) && text(SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__BillingFrequency__c) = 'Quarterly' && text(Division__c) = 'ALM' && SBQQ__Bundle__c = FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add "Q" to promo code if Billing Frequency is Quarterly
